customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile; one profile per person, whether they ride, drive or both

name.meaning: full legal name as it appears on the profile

phone_number.meaning: mobile number registered to the profile and used to sign in

email.meaning: email address registered to the profile, lower case

date_of_birth.meaning: date of birth on the profile, as entered at sign-up (drivers: as on the driver's license)

payment_card_last4.meaning: last four digits of the default payment card on the profile

account_created_date.meaning: date the profile was first opened

account_role.meaning: which sides of the platform the profile uses

home_market.meaning: metro market the profile is registered in (airport codes stand for the metro: DEN Denver, COS Colorado Springs, SLC Salt Lake City, PHX Phoenix, TUS Tucson, LAS Las Vegas, ABQ Albuquerque)

rider_rating.meaning: rider's current average star rating from drivers (5.00 when not yet rated)

pass_membership_id.meaning: primary id of the Wayfare Pass membership

variant_name.meaning: the Wayfare Pass plan held, as the official plan name

status.meaning: membership lifecycle state (see the Wayfare Pass charter lifecycle)

signup_channel.meaning: how the membership was taken out; card_partner_offer means the fee is covered by a partner credit card benefit and is not billed to the member

trial_end_date.meaning: last day of the free trial; empty when no trial was granted

current_period_start.meaning: first day of the billing period in force

current_period_end.meaning: last day of the billing period in force (inclusive); the renewal charge falls on the next day

auto_renew.meaning: whether the membership renews automatically at the end of the period in force

student_verified_until.meaning: last day the student verification is valid; empty for non-student plans

last_paused_date.meaning: date the most recent pause began; empty if never paused

paused_until.meaning: date a pause in force ends (membership resumes the next day); empty when not paused

cancelled_date.meaning: date the membership ended; empty while not cancelled

member_credit_balance.meaning: Pass ride credits currently available to spend; identically the sum of the member_credit account deltas

net_fees_paid.meaning: membership fees billed less fees refunded over the life of the membership; identically the sum of the membership_fees account deltas

pass_event_id.meaning: primary id of the membership ledger entry

pass_membership_id.meaning: membership the entry belongs to (foreign key -> pass_memberships)

amount.meaning: signed amount: fee charges and credits earned are positive; fee refunds, credits redeemed and credits forfeited are negative; 0.00 on payment declines

billing_period_start.meaning: first day of the billing period the fee, refund or decline relates to; for credit entries the period in force when the trip completed

charge_reason.meaning: why a fee was charged or attempted; none on credit entries

retry_number.meaning: payment attempt number for a decline (0 = the scheduled attempt, 1-3 = retries); 0 on other entries

original_event_id.meaning: for a fee refund, the fee charge it returns; for a credit forfeiture caused by a trip refund, the credit earn it reverses; empty otherwise

trip_id.meaning: trip a credit was earned or redeemed on (foreign key -> trips); empty on fee entries

credit_month.meaning: calendar month a credit entry counts toward for the monthly credit cap; empty on fee entries

refund_basis.meaning: the refund rule applied on a fee refund; none on other entries

forfeit_reason.meaning: why credits were forfeited; none on other entries

customer_id.meaning: rider who requested the trip (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: the ride option requested, as the official ride option name

status.meaning: trip lifecycle state (see the trip charter lifecycle)

booking_mode.meaning: on_demand = requested for now; reserved = booked ahead through Wayfare Reserve

market.meaning: metro market the trip started in

requested_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)
requested_at.meaning: moment the rider requested or reserved the trip

scheduled_pickup_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)
scheduled_pickup_at.meaning: reserved pickup time for reserved trips; empty for on-demand trips

accepted_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)
accepted_at.meaning: moment a driver accepted the trip; empty if never accepted

original_eta_minutes.meaning: driver's estimated minutes to pickup shown to the rider at acceptance; 0 if never accepted

driver_arrived_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)
driver_arrived_at.meaning: moment the driver marked arrival at the pickup point; empty if the driver never arrived

pickup_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)
pickup_at.meaning: moment the rider was picked up and the trip started; empty if it never started

dropoff_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)
dropoff_at.meaning: moment the trip ended at drop-off; empty if it never completed

cancelled_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)
cancelled_at.meaning: moment the trip was cancelled or marked no-show; empty otherwise

driver_customer_id.meaning: profile of the driver who accepted the trip (foreign key -> customers); empty if never accepted

driver_agreement_id.meaning: driver services agreement the trip was driven under (foreign key -> driver_agreements); empty if never accepted

pass_membership_id.meaning: rider's Wayfare Pass membership in force when the trip was requested (foreign key -> pass_memberships); empty when none

airport_code.meaning: airport the trip picked up at or dropped off at; none when neither end is an airport

airport_leg.meaning: which end of the trip was at the airport

estimated_miles.meaning: route distance estimated at request and used for the upfront fare

estimated_minutes.meaning: trip duration estimated at request and used for the upfront fare

actual_miles.meaning: distance actually driven from pickup to drop-off (0.00 if not completed)

actual_minutes.meaning: duration actually driven from pickup to drop-off (0 if not completed)

rider_changed_route.meaning: whether the rider added a stop or changed the destination during the trip

surge_multiplier.meaning: busy-time multiplier in force when the trip was requested

upfront_fare.meaning: fare quoted to the rider before requesting, before Pass discounts and credits

seats_requested.meaning: number of riders the request was made for

net_charged.meaning: everything charged to the rider for this trip less adjustments and refunds; identically the sum of the rider_charges account deltas

outstanding_amount.meaning: charges on this trip that failed to collect and are still unpaid; identically the sum of the outstanding_balance account deltas

trip_charge_id.meaning: primary id of the trip charge entry

trip_id.meaning: trip the entry belongs to (foreign key -> trips)

charged_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)

amount.meaning: signed amount: charges are positive, fare adjustments and refunds negative; payment failures carry the uncollected amount as positive and settlements as negative; waivers record the fee that was not charged as 0.00

pass_membership_id.meaning: Wayfare Pass membership whose benefit applied to this entry (foreign key -> pass_memberships); empty when no Pass benefit applied

member_discount_amount.meaning: Pass member discount taken off the fare on a fare charge; 0.00 otherwise

member_credit_applied.meaning: Pass ride credits used to pay this fare charge; 0.00 otherwise

payment_source.meaning: how a fare charge was paid; none on entries that are not fare charges

fare_basis.meaning: how the fare on a fare charge was set; none on other entries

wait_minutes_billed.meaning: billable wait minutes on a wait time charge; 0 otherwise

toll_facility.meaning: toll road crossed on a toll charge; none otherwise

airport_code.meaning: airport on an airport surcharge; none otherwise

original_charge_id.meaning: for an adjustment, refund, payment failure or settlement, the trip charge it relates to; empty otherwise

adjustment_reason.meaning: the reason code on an adjustment or refund; none otherwise

waiver_basis.meaning: why a fee that would otherwise apply was not charged, on a waiver entry; none otherwise

waived_fee_type.meaning: which fee a waiver entry stands in for; none otherwise

settlement_method.meaning: how an outstanding charge was settled; none otherwise

fare_review_id.meaning: primary id of the fare review request

customer_id.meaning: rider who asked for the review (foreign key -> customers)

trip_charge_id.meaning: the specific charge the rider disputes (foreign key -> trip_charges)

review_reason.meaning: what the rider says is wrong with the charge

requested_amount.meaning: the adjustment amount being sent for review (positive number)

review_status.meaning: outcome of the fare review team; submitted while pending

created_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)
created_at.meaning: moment the review request was registered

damage_assessment_id.meaning: primary id of the cleaning or damage fee assessment

customer_id.meaning: rider the fee is assessed against (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: the fee level assessed, as the official fee level name

status.meaning: assessment lifecycle state (see the cleaning and damage fee charter lifecycle)

trip_id.meaning: trip on which the mess or damage occurred (foreign key -> trips)

driver_customer_id.meaning: profile of the driver who reported (foreign key -> customers)

driver_agreement_id.meaning: driver services agreement of the reporting driver (foreign key -> driver_agreements)

reported_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)
reported_at.meaning: moment the driver's report was registered

photo_count.meaning: number of photos the driver has submitted for this report

repair_receipt_amount.meaning: total of the repair receipt or professional cleaning receipt submitted; 0.00 when none

assessed_fee.meaning: fee currently assessed at the level held; 0.00 until approved

charged_date.meaning: date the fee was charged to the rider; empty until charged

dispute_filed_date.meaning: date the rider disputed the fee; empty if never disputed

closed_date.meaning: date the assessment reached denied, upheld or reversed; empty while open

net_fee_billed.meaning: fee charged less refunds; identically the sum of the fee_billed account deltas

damage_event_id.meaning: primary id of the assessment ledger entry

damage_assessment_id.meaning: assessment the entry belongs to (foreign key -> damage_assessments)

customer_id.meaning: rider the assessment is against (foreign key -> customers)

recorded_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)

amount.meaning: signed amount: fee charges positive, refunds negative; 0.00 on evidence entries

evidence_type.meaning: kind of evidence on an evidence entry; none otherwise

evidence_count.meaning: number of photos or documents in an evidence submission; 0 otherwise

fee_level.meaning: fee level the entry was booked at (for a partial refund, the level the fee was reduced to)

original_event_id.meaning: for a refund or partial refund, the fee charge it returns money from; empty otherwise

refund_reason.meaning: reason code on a refund or partial refund; none otherwise

earnings_account_id.meaning: primary id of the driver's earnings account

driver_agreement_id.meaning: driver services agreement the account pays out for (foreign key -> driver_agreements)

variant_name.meaning: the Wayfare Pro status in force for the current quarter, as the official status name

closed_date.meaning: date the account was closed; empty while open

payout_hold_reason.meaning: why payouts are held; none when not on hold

tier_period_start.meaning: first day of the calendar quarter the current Pro status applies to

available_balance.meaning: earnings posted and not yet paid out, net of deductions (may be negative); identically the sum of the earnings_balance account deltas

pro_points_balance.meaning: Pro points earned in the current quarter; identically the sum of the pro_points account deltas

earnings_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the earnings ledger entry

earnings_account_id.meaning: earnings account the entry posts to (foreign key -> earnings_accounts)

posted_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)

amount.meaning: signed amount: credits positive, debits, cashouts, payouts and fees negative; 0.00 on points entries

points.meaning: Pro points credited (positive) or reset (negative); 0 on money entries

trip_id.meaning: trip the entry relates to (foreign key -> trips); empty when not trip-related

damage_assessment_id.meaning: cleaning or damage assessment a payout or clawback relates to (foreign key -> damage_assessments); empty otherwise

bonus_offer_id.meaning: incentive offer a bonus payout or clawback relates to (foreign key -> bonus_offers); empty otherwise

rental_charge_id.meaning: rental charge a rental deduction pays (foreign key -> rental_charges); empty otherwise

original_entry_id.meaning: for a cashout fee, the cashout it belongs to; for an adjustment, the ledger entry it corrects; empty otherwise

adjustment_reason.meaning: reason code on an adjustment; none otherwise

points_basis.meaning: how a points credit was earned; none otherwise

points_period_start.meaning: first day of the quarter a points entry belongs to; empty on money entries

payout_week_start.meaning: Monday of the earnings week a scheduled payout covers; empty otherwise

payout_type.meaning: kind of payout; none on other entries

cashout_channel.meaning: where an instant cashout (and its fee) was sent; none otherwise

bonus_offer_id.meaning: primary id of the incentive offer entry

earnings_account_id.meaning: earnings account the offer was made to (foreign key -> earnings_accounts)

issued_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)
issued_at.meaning: moment the offer was issued or the opt-in was recorded

market.meaning: market the offer is valid in

window_start.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)
window_start.meaning: start of the period in which qualifying trips count

window_end.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)
window_end.meaning: end of the period in which qualifying trips count (exclusive)

target_trip_count.meaning: qualifying trips required (quest, consecutive trips, referral) or 0 for a guarantee

reward_amount.meaning: bonus paid when the target is met; 0.00 for a guarantee

guaranteed_amount.meaning: minimum earnings promised over the window for an earnings guarantee; 0.00 for other incentives

required_online_minutes.meaning: minimum time online in the window an earnings guarantee requires; 0 for other incentives

source_offer_id.meaning: on an opt-in entry, the offer issue entry it opts into; empty on issue entries

referred_customer_id.meaning: for a referral offer, the profile of the new driver referred (foreign key -> customers); empty otherwise

driver_agreement_id.meaning: primary id of the driver services agreement

variant_name.meaning: the service level the driver is contracted for, as the official agreement name

market.meaning: market the driver is licensed to drive in

signed_date.meaning: date the driver signed the agreement

activated_date.meaning: date the agreement first became active; empty before activation

closed_date.meaning: date the agreement was closed; empty while not closed

vehicle_model_year.meaning: model year of the vehicle registered to the agreement

vehicle_seats.meaning: passenger seats in the registered vehicle, excluding the driver

license_expiry_date.meaning: expiry date of the driver's license on file

insurance_expiry_date.meaning: expiry date of the personal auto insurance on file

inspection_expiry_date.meaning: expiry date of the vehicle inspection on file

commercial_permit_expiry_date.meaning: expiry date of the for-hire / luxury permit on file (Black and Black SUV); empty for other levels

background_check_date.meaning: completion date of the most recent clear background check

hold_reason.meaning: why the agreement is on hold; none when not on hold

hold_started_date.meaning: date the hold in force began; empty when not on hold

deactivation_reason.meaning: why the agreement was deactivated; none when not deactivated

deactivation_date.meaning: date of the deactivation in force; empty when not deactivated

current_rating.meaning: average of the driver's most recent rated trips over the rating window

rated_trips_count.meaning: number of rated trips in the driver's rating window (capped at the window size)

driver_standing_event_id.meaning: primary id of the standing record entry

driver_agreement_id.meaning: agreement the entry belongs to (foreign key -> driver_agreements)

recorded_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)

document_type.meaning: document on a document entry; none otherwise

document_expiry_date.meaning: expiry date shown on a submitted document or covered by an expiry notice; empty otherwise

notice_sequence.meaning: 1 for the first notice or warning of its kind in the current cycle, 2 for the second; 0 otherwise

rating_at_review.meaning: rating window average at a rating review or rating warning; 0.00 otherwise

rated_trips_in_window.meaning: rated trips in the window at a rating review; 0 otherwise

cancellation_rate_pct.meaning: driver cancellation rate over the measurement window at a review or warning; 0.0 otherwise

warning_basis.meaning: what a quality warning is about; none otherwise

safety_report_category.meaning: category of a safety report; none otherwise

related_trip_id.meaning: trip a safety report concerns (foreign key -> trips); empty otherwise

recheck_result.meaning: result of a background recheck; none otherwise

driver_appeal_id.meaning: primary id of the appeal or reactivation request

driver_agreement_id.meaning: agreement the appeal concerns (foreign key -> driver_agreements)

appeal_status.meaning: outcome of the review; submitted while pending

submitted_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)

decided_date.meaning: date the review decided; empty while pending

rental_agreement_id.meaning: primary id of the weekly vehicle rental agreement

customer_id.meaning: driver renting the vehicle (foreign key -> customers)

driver_agreement_id.meaning: driver services agreement the rental is used under (foreign key -> driver_agreements)

variant_name.meaning: vehicle class rented, as the official rental class name

rental_hub.meaning: rental hub the vehicle is collected from and returned to

vehicle_plate.meaning: license plate of the rented vehicle, as printed on the rental contract

pickup_date.meaning: date the vehicle was collected; empty before pickup

return_due_date.meaning: date the vehicle must be back at the hub when a return has been required; empty otherwise

returned_date.meaning: date the vehicle was returned; empty before return

closed_date.meaning: date the rental was closed; empty while open

odometer_in.meaning: odometer reading at return; 0 before return

balance_due.meaning: rental charges not yet paid; identically the sum of the rental_balance account deltas

deposit_held.meaning: security deposit currently held; identically the sum of the rental_deposit account deltas

rental_charge_id.meaning: primary id of the rental ledger entry

rental_agreement_id.meaning: rental the entry belongs to (foreign key -> rental_agreements)

customer_id.meaning: driver renting the vehicle (foreign key -> customers)

amount.meaning: signed amount: charges and deposit holds positive; rebates, payments, offsets and deposit releases or applications negative

rental_week_start.meaning: first day of the rental week a weekly charge, rebate or mileage overage covers; empty otherwise

miles_over.meaning: miles above the weekly allowance on an overage entry; 0 otherwise

damage_category.meaning: damage on a damage charge; none otherwise

toll_facility.meaning: toll road on a toll charge; none otherwise

original_charge_id.meaning: charge a payment, offset or deposit application settles; empty otherwise

bike_plan_id.meaning: primary id of the bike and scooter plan

customer_id.meaning: rider holding the plan (foreign key -> customers)

values: Wayfare Bikes Pay As You Ride
variant_name.meaning: the bike and scooter plan held, as the official plan name

market.meaning: bike share system the plan is for

expires_date.meaning: last day the plan is valid (inclusive)

cancelled_date.meaning: date the plan was cancelled; empty otherwise

net_charged.meaning: everything charged under the plan less refunds; identically the sum of the bike_charges account deltas

bike_charge_id.meaning: primary id of the bike and scooter charge entry

bike_plan_id.meaning: plan the entry is billed under (foreign key -> bike_plans)

event_type.meaning: bike and scooter charge event family

ride_started_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)
ride_started_at.meaning: moment the ride was unlocked; empty on plan fees

vehicle_type.meaning: vehicle ridden; none on plan fees

ride_minutes.meaning: ride length rounded up to the whole minute; 0 on plan fees

amount.meaning: signed amount: charges positive, refunds negative

original_charge_id.meaning: for a refund, the charge it returns; empty otherwise

refund_reason.meaning: reason code on a refund; none otherwise

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity verification record (one per customer)

verified.meaning: whether verification passed; never goes back from true to false

verified_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human handoff record

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ (local market time with zone abbreviation, the same form the system clock returns)
